findings.finding: The cause is complete and dated (Q1 FY27 release 2026-10-07, two sessions traded since) and the primary filings show no dated supply, solvency or listing event that can land between today's close and Monday's close: no ATM or shelf language ever, no going-concern language, covenant-compliant at 2026-08-29 with no borrowings and $24.1m undrawn, $2.81 well above the $1 bid rule, annual meeting not until 2026-10-22.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Leg-2 absence finding: the window (close 10-09 to close 10-12) contains no dated event from the issuer's filings; the second-shoe channels that drive the base-rate drift for fallers (offering, covenant, deficiency) are checked and empty, which differentiates RGP from fallers in the same day that carry one.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After its prior post-earnings drops RGP's next session was +6.67% (2026-01-08, -14.61%) and +0.27% (2026-07-23, -18.44%); its own day-two continuation today (-6.02% after -20.05%) shows the selling has not yet stopped. Own falls overall: n=31, 58.1% up, median +0.59% (baseline).
findings.why_not_priced: The price is pricing the earnings content; the cross-section prior for fallers (-1.77% next session) embeds an average rate of second shoes that RGP's filings do not show inside this window. If the market priced a pending second shoe for RGP specifically there would be a filing or scheduled date to point to; none exists.
